scheme_name: Scheme for Award of Scholarships to School or College-Going Children of Employees/Industrial Employees in Various Establishments
other_conditions: Applicant must be a regular worker employed in an industrial establishment for at least six months
The industrial establishment must be covered under the Goa, Daman & Diu Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1986
Applicant must perform any skilled or unskilled, manual or clerical labour, not in a supervisory or managerial position
Applicant's total salary income (including allowances and perks, exclusive of bonus) must not exceed ₹20,000 per month
Child must be enrolled in a recognized institution in India
Child must be pursuing general or technical education (including medical, engineering, agricultural studies)
Child must have secured at least 45% marks in the last annual examination for promotion
Research or higher learning (PhD, M.Phil, M.D., M.S.) after postgraduate courses are eligible
Scholarship amount is provided only to the extent it exceeds any other scholarship or stipend the student receives
benefits_summary: Scholarships of ₹2,000 to ₹20,000 are awarded annually in a single instalment, disbursed via ECS to the parents' bank account.
documents_required: Prescribed application form (print from the Official Website of the Department of Labour and Employment, Goa)
Self-attested copies of all mandatory documents
